evidence.detail: ruff hook only runs --select I (import sort only); no mypy hook present; neither flake8 nor full ruff linting is enforced at commit time
do_check() runs mypy + full ruff lint + jslint but is never called from pre-commit — only from manual 'check'/'full-check' subcommands
pre-push hook runs './dev.py' with no subcommand, which is a click CLI that prints help and exits 0 — effectively a no-op for enforcement

triage.fix_sketch: In .pre-commit-config.yaml: (1) add a second ruff hook (or modify the existing one) without --select I to run full linting on commit; (2) add a mypy hook using repo: local with language: system pointing to dev.py mypy (or using the official mirrors-mypy pre-commit hook with additional_dependencies matching requirements). ~15-25 lines in .pre-commit-config.yaml only.
triage.notes: Adding mypy to pre-commit may require specifying additional_dependencies to satisfy third-party stubs; the project's existing mypy configuration in dev.py (do_mypy) shows what flags to use. Should be tested locally before merging to avoid blocking all commits.
